notes.title: Update arrived! Better graphics|New Island|New effects|More
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

The Survive update has finally arrived!

 Added:    

-New Island, which also increases how realistic the game looks. This island is bigger and all the smaller islands were removed to have this large island.

-New pickable bush. You can now get plant fibre from picking up green bushes when going next to them.

-New effects when mining trees and rocks

-Moving clouds added

-New water added (put the old one back as the other one we had wasn't that good)

-Menu backdrop changed to the current island

-Minor changes to some item descriptions

If you enjoy Survive more now, please consider writing a review! Thank you.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

Survive is going to be getting an update soon! It will include a few new features that we hope you will enjoy.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: New Island | New starting location | New Water [Version 1]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Version 1 of Survive has arrived! It includes a new island which now makes the game have a total of 3 islands. A new starting location of a crashed boat is now in-place and there is new water implemented.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update Tomorrow! New island | New water | New starting area
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

Tommorow Survive will recieve it's last content update to bring it to version 1. It will include many other features that we did not originally intend for it to contain, but it should make the game more enjoyable!

The game will include a new island, which contains a major mountain in the middle of the island. The game will also include new water and a new starting area. You will first spawn on a boat that has crashed. The boat will include water physics and barrels to increase the immersion. However, the plane crash will still be kept on the island.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update has arrived! [Version 0.95]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Version 0.95 for Survive has been released! Please see below to view the additions/changes.

Additions:    



 New leather helmet

 New wooden helmet

 Plane crash added on the island



Changes:    



 The players health has been changed to starting with 100 instead of 45, and the max you can now have is 100.

 Spawn point locations changed to near the plane crash



Part 2 of this update will include an extension to the map, which will make Survive go to version 1, the final version.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update will arrive soon! Extra addition!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The Survive update will be arriving in about 2 days, and it will include everything in the last announcement and also an extension to the map.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Next update soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The next Survive update will be arriving soon! It will include 2 new types of helmets (leather and wood), the health value for the start of the game will be changed to 100 instead of 45 and the maximum value of health changed to 100. In addition, it will include a plane crash which will contribute to the story of the game of how you ended up on the island.

Another feature that could be added is another island on the map, however, we would like your thoughts if we should do this or just keep the size it is at the moment.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Patch!
notes.notes:

A small patch has been released which fixes an issue regarding a spawn point. It was beneath the map which could cause players to spawn beneath the map. But this has now been fixed.

notes.title: Update is here! New Island| New Item| More!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The new Survive update is here! It includes a map expansion, with a new island, new item (a medical kit), some crafting recipe requirements have also been changed to integrate the smelting system even more. The new island includes a volcano which can be seen emitting smoke.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Next Update Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The next update for Survive should include a new buildable! We also plan to fix an issue, and possibly add another healing item! Some crafting recipe requirements may also be changed to incorporate the new smelting system more instead of it being used for only a couple of items. Please also note that the guide for Survive is live.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update is here! New Item|Smelting System|Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

The Survive update is finally here! It introduces a new object, fixes and a smelting system!

Additions:    

-New head gear

-Smelting system-Craft a campfire, place wood in the slot, then place rocks in the other slot, then iron ingots will come out.

Fixes:    

-Some trees near the waterfall have been removed

-Wood now has longer durability in the fire again

Changes:    

-Some crafting recipe requirements have been changed

Note: Restart Steam to receive this update    

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Release date|Servers|Next update soon
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

The release date for Survive is scheduled for the 11th of August. The next Survive update will be tomorrow. It will include: The new textures, lakes, waterfall, new buildable (a fence has been implemented) and a chat system where you can communicate with other players. The servers can fit a maximum of 20 players.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Next update soon! New Textures|Lakes
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

The next Survive update will include new textures for the island and will also include lakes that can be found throughout the map. We currently have about 1 lake but it has too many plants that cover it, and this will be fixed. A fixed release date will be mentioned in another announcement.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Quick Update (release date, images soon)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Soon we will be showing some new images of the crafting and inventory system. We are currently working on making new craftable items. The game will not be going onto EA (Early Access) and is just a small project. The game will be priced very cheap, and we may be doing updates to it to keep the game fresh after it has been released.

We expect Survive to be released in August, and may have an official server running, however, you can host your own servers from the menu.

Interactive Gaming Studios
